{{Quote|My rule is simple. You will obey me&mdash;or you will die.|Darth Rauder to Gunner Yage|<ref name="Legacy 45" />}}
'''Darth Rauder''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] in [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith|Order]] and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]]. In [[138 ABY]], she commanded the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] contingent of [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] aboard the [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[War Hammer]]'', [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce]]. During [[Operation: Thunderstroke]], the Sith Empire's attempt to capture deposed Emperor [[Roan Fel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]], Rauder led the [[1st Imperial Center Core Defense Squadron]] into battle in Agamar's orbit. After the battle, which saw Fel successfully evade the Sith forces, Rauder participated in the [[Devastation of Da Soocha|devastation]] of [[Da Soocha]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Napdu]], with her and Skull Squadron eliminating any civilian [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] attempting to escape the planet and its moon. Later, Rauder was involved in the Sith Empire's [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|assault]] on the planet [[Taivas]], which was the location of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order's]] [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]]. During the fracas, Rauder ordered Skull Squadron's [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Gunn Yage]] to shoot down a starship carrying [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]]. Yage refused and turned against Rauder, shooting down the Sith Lady's [[Sith-Imperial starfighter|starfighter]] and [[Death/Legends|killing]] her.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The squadron I am to lead must be able to adapt.|Darth Rauder|<ref name="Legacy 45" />}}
Darth Rauder was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] that was born during the time period of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] and the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. By [[137 ABY]], she had ascended to the rank of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] in [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith|Sith Order]], earning the "[[Darth/Legends|Darth]]" title.<ref name="Legacy 45" /> When the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith-Imperial]] forces learned that deposed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] was secretly rendezvousing with members of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] to discuss an alliance on the planet [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]], Rauder and other [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] pilots accompanied the [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce]] to travel to Agamar and capture Fel. As the fleet was in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], Rauder had the [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class fighters]] of the [[1st Imperial Center Core Defense Squadron]], led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gunn Yage]], replaced with [[Sith-Imperial starfighter|Sith-designed ships]]. When Yage questioned Rauder's actions, the Sith warned her to obey her orders or face [[Death/Legends|death]].

Rauder forced [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gunn Yage]]'s [[1st Imperial Center Core Defense Squadron|Squadron]] to switch over to a new design of [[Sith-Imperial starfighter|Sith-designed starfighter]] instead of the Predators they were more familiar with, causing Yage to protest. Rauder threatened to kill Yage if she did not follow her orders.

During [[Operation: Thunderstroke]], Lady Rauder flew with Skull Squadron as "'''Skull Leader'''". During the battle, she ordered Captain Yage and the members of Skull Squadron to fire on a pilot of the [[Empire-in-exile|Bastion resistance]] who ejected from their starfighters. When Yage refused, the Sith Lady began to torture her using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and threatened to [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] kill her. However, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tev Rimon]] shot the pilot instead, sparing Yage the choice of killing an unarmed enemy. Though Rauder spared Yage, the Sith Lady wasn't pleased and threatened to kill Rimon if he went against her orders again.

[[File:DeathofRauder.jpg|thumb|left|140px|Gunn Yage shoots down Darth Rauder.]]
Lady Rauder was also present during the [[Devastation of Da Soocha|poisoning]] of [[Da Soocha]] and the bombing of [[Napdu]] under the command of Sith Lord [[Darth Azard]], Moff Yage and scientist [[Vul Isen]]. Aboard her [[Fury-class starfighter|Sith Fury]], Rauder labeled the civilian vessels fleeing Napdu as "enemy combatants", despite them being unarmed, and ordered the member of Skull Squadron to destroy them. Though Tev Rimon and [[Jae Akura]] protested, Captain Yage acquiesced and told her subordinates to follow the Sith Lady's command.

A few months later, in [[138 ABY]], Lady Rauder lead Skull Squadron during the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple]]. Under her guidance, many allied and Fel loyalist starfighters were taken out. As the battle raged on, Jedi Master [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]] ordered the ships that formed the Hidden Temple to take flight and escape. Aboard one of these ships, Masters [[Tili Qua]] and [[K'Kruhk]] took a number of Jedi younglings to safety. Sensing their presence aboard the ship, Rauder ordered Skull Squadron to destroy it. However, Captain Yage refused to murder defenseless children, and, fed up with the Sith, obliterated Rauder's starfighter, and with it, Rauder herself. Unwilling to serve the Sith any longer, Yage defected to the Empire-in-exile, followed by her father and many other disillusioned Imperials who were through with the Sith.

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Rauder_napdu.jpg|thumb|right|140px|Darth Rauder during the [[Devastation of Da Soocha]].]]
{{Quote|Obey me, Captain Yage! Kill the enemy, or I will kill you.|Darth Rauder|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 46">[[Legacy (2006) 46|''Legacy'' (2006) 46]]</ref>}}
Darth Rauder was a fanatically loyal member of the One Sith. She demonstrated no mercy to those she deemed enemies of the Sith, regardless of their ability to defend themselves, ordering the death of unarmed enemy soldiers or even civilians. As a military commander, she had little tolerance for subordinates who questioned her orders, and had no qualms about torturing and killing those that defied her.

Unlike other female Sith Ladies, Rauder sported a short-trimmed hairstyle.

==Powers and abilities==
Darth Rauder was a skilled pilot but was still able to be shot down by Captain Yage. Rauder contained a fair ability with [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]], but she could not sense Yage's intention to shoot her down. Rauder excelled at [[Torture/Legends|torture]]. Any whiff of insubordination and that person would suffer the pains of being tortured by Rauder with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
